bio: Software Engineer with 2.6 years of experience building cross-platform mobile applications for Android and iOS. Skilled in Flutter, Dart, React Native, REST API integration, Firebase, GetX architecture, responsive UI, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Experienced across the SDLC from requirement analysis and UI/UX collaboration to development, QA, deployment, and delivery.

bullets: Design and build high-performance Android and iOS applications using Flutter, Dart, React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Contribute across requirement analysis, UI/UX design, coding, testing, deployment, and release delivery.
Conduct unit, functional, and integration testing to improve mobile app reliability, performance, and scalability.
Integrate REST APIs, Firebase services, and third-party SDKs while implementing scalable state management with GetX.
experience.desc: Cross-platform mobile app engineering across Flutter, React Native, API integration, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.

bullets: Designed and developed Android and iOS applications using Flutter and Dart with clean, reusable, and testable code.
Collaborated with backend, UI/UX, and QA teams to deliver well-integrated mobile features on schedule.
Improved responsiveness and stability by fixing bugs, optimizing widget rendering, and tuning Flutter performance.
Supported planning and prioritization for smooth project delivery, releases, and client satisfaction.
experience.desc: Flutter mobile application development with strong focus on code quality, performance, team collaboration, and reliable delivery.
